tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation decisively refutes the fitted thresholded siphon, while the archive offers several competing smooth gradient-dependent laws. Additional varied trajectory data is the best available route to discriminate them; the current evidence does not justify abstention.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh-confirmation RMSE of 0.644 is far above tolerance, so tuning that same branch is not supported.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a gradient-inhibited Hill or barrier-modulated siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These remain plausible stationary alternatives, but the available rows largely co-vary u_now and s_grad, making their distinct effects difficult to identify.
The existing high-gradient observations already show the sign reversal; another probe in the same regime is less likely to resolve structural ambiguity.
One stationary model was refuted, but there is no evidence of non-stationary high-frequency oscillation or that all smooth mechanisms fail.
